title: Human caller, OTP request
summary: A caller poses as a bank employee and asks for a one-time code. Voice authenticity is not assessed.
voice_note: Written as a natural human caller. No audio is bundled, so voice authenticity stays inconclusive. The warning is driven by the conversation alone.

expected.note: High conversational risk and an immediate warning at 00:18. The repeated request at 00:28 does not ping again.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Hello sir, good afternoon. This is Rahul calling from the bank's fraud prevention department.

events.speaker: you
events.text: Oh, hello. What is this about?

events.speaker: caller
events.text: We noticed an unusual transaction on your card, and I want to help you secure your account.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: A verification code has just been sent to your phone.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Please read the code you just received so I can secure your account.

events.speaker: you
events.text: Is it safe to share it? I thought the bank never asks for it.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Yes sir, it is completely safe. Just read the code to me, it is only for verification.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Sir, please hurry, the transaction will go through in two minutes.
